applicability: Choose actual supported device/platform controls and exclude legitimately inapplicable mechanics with explanation; a plan is not a certification.

checks.mechanism: Keyboard/controller mapping options; verify full playable path with one alternate layout
Menus, settings, pause and gameplay navigable via declared supported input method
Touch targets separated and large enough for intended device; test controls without accidental activation
Alternatives to prolonged hold/timed input and adjustable sensitivity where applicable
All important speech and cutscene/dialogue carry readable subtitles
Essential audio-only signals have readable visual equivalent/caption
Soundtrack, dialog and effects can be balanced or muted separately where present
UI, dialogue and error text can be read at every supported resolution with scalable font/layout
Text and critical UI readable against all game backgrounds including bright effects
Never communicate gameplay-critical state only through fixed color
Evaluate rapid flashing, motion and camera behavior; supply safer options when relevant
Important prompts have reading time, accessible replay and understandable instructions
Accessibility preferences remain saved across restart/reload on a tested supported platform
Claim accessibility options only if available and tested; align store tags and downloadable/browser builds

data_collection_policy: No collection of medical/disability characteristics of individual players; use voluntary non-sensitive feedback with consent when available.
rule: A source-backed plan may be complete, but actual per-build compliance, QA costs and commercial impact remain unknown until authorized testing.
